title: Forward Tangent-Centered Sinkhorn DRO: Exact Nominal Recovery from Optimal Transport to KL
summary: Fixed-reference entropy-regularized transport yields smooth distributionally robust optimization (DRO) objectives, but its value as a function of the adversarial marginal is generally minimized at a kernel-smoothed law rather than at the nominal distribution. Consequently, the smallest raw ambiguity set need not recover nominal risk. Building on prior information-geometric plan-KL orientations, we study the forward tangent-centered discrepancy obtained by subtracting the value and first variation at the nominal law.
